title: Dreamer defends ECW against Jerry Lawler
summary: Jerry Lawler dismisses ECW and then enters its own arena with Sabu and Rob Van Dam as allies. Tommy Dreamer becomes the defender of the promotion’s identity.

chapters.title: ECW appears on Raw
chapters.result: ECW wrestlers appear on Raw as Heyman and Lawler trade insults.
chapters.context: This is the 1997 promotional crossover, distinct from WWE’s 2001 Invasion.

chapters.title: Lawler invades the ECW Arena
chapters.result: Lawler joins Sabu and Van Dam in attacking Dreamer.
chapters.context: The assault interrupts Dreamer’s celebration after finally beating Raven.

chapters.title: Dreamer defeats Lawler
chapters.result: Dreamer wins their singles match with Beulah’s help.
chapters.context: The result gives ECW’s representative a victory over its most vocal outside antagonist.
